document:0:227:0.text:
At the foot of the colossal mountain guarded by Misarte lies a small human town called Sita.

Sita is backed by mountains, surrounded by water on three sides. Rugged terrain makes it unfit for normal settlements, but the people here built hollow-wood platforms for their homes.

Most platforms rise two or three men high. During Mistcloud month, the rainy season, the water rises about half a man's height. People here call it a miracle of the gods of earth and river.

In my view, Misarte only wishes to keep the mountain in peace. She dwells far from the other gods, longing for tranquility in all her deeds.

If all gods were like this, the world would know no disasters... Life would be free of suffering. What a beautiful thought.

<align="right">Merlin
<align="right">Mistvine Month, in Sita
document:0:227:0.source_cn:
弥萨忒守护的巨山山脚下，存在一座人类小城，名为辞达。
辞达城一面依山，三面环水，地势崎岖，这种地理环境并不适合发展聚落。但辞达人用空心木搭建平台，将房屋建于平台之上。
平台大多离水面两人或三人高。雨季来临——当地称之为绵云月——水面大约会上涨半人高。辞达人以为此乃大地与河川之神的神迹。
以我之见，弥萨忒只是在守卫巨山的安定。它远离诸神，栖居于此，种种举动皆是为了寻求宁静。
若是诸神皆能如此，世间再无灾难，生灵将不被囿于苦难之间……多么美好的夙愿。
<align="right">梅林
<align="right">芽蔓月，辞达城
